_doc: Which Cockpit section (portfolio) each thing appears in. Sections: ai-thrival, micropace, investments, research, family. Unlisted boards go to defaultGroup. channels = gateway platforms to show (empty = all). lanes = worker lanes to check. links = other tools shown in the sidebar, one group per `group` name, placed before Operations (each opens in a new tab; add a line per tool function). dashboardUrl = link to the Hermes dashboard from the header ({host} = page hostname; publish with: tailscale serve --bg --https=9443 9119). allowedHosts = hostnames Cockpit may be reached by besides localhost. Lane models live in lanes/models.conf.
